text:
cheng: kicking off a short thread for the eu-west3 capacity primer + soak tuning. goal: 6h soak at sustained 65-75% GPU util (p50 latency target), with 30% burst headroom for traffic spikes. want to capture config we actually run and any region constraints.

kari: sounds good. quick Q — do we expect preemptible/spot to be usable in eu-west3 for H100s? cost tradeoffs matter.

aj: quick note: eu-west3 has limited preemptible H100s right now (we saw 0-2 availability windows last week). A100s are more available. plan presumes mix: 70% A100 on-demand pool + 30% H100 spot for burst.

infra-bot: [capacity-snapshot 1912345600] pools:
- eu-west3-a: 12 x A100 (on-demand)
- eu-west3-b: 8 x A100 (on-demand)
- eu-west3-c: 4 x H100 (spot-eligible)
quotas: GPU quota 28/64 (requested 36 increase pending)

samir: FYI when we ran a short smoke yesterday we saw intermittent control-plane reconnects during a 20% burst — looked like ephemeral route-table churn between AZs. not sure if it was cloud-side or our egress NAT.

liz: open question: do we run soak only within single-AZ to avoid cross-AZ networking noise? or test cross-AZ since customers will hit multi-AZ?

cheng: good point. plan: 2 phases. phase 1 (single-AZ soak): 6h at 70% util inside eu-west3-a to validate autoscaler and batching; phase 2 (cross-AZ soak + spike): 4h with controlled 40-60% cross-AZ traffic + 2x 10-min spikes to validate fallback routing and extra latency.

kari: recommended autoscaler tuning for phase1?

aj: proposed autoscaler snippets (apply to cluster-autoscaler config):
```
# autoscaler tuning highlights
scaleDownUtilization: 0.20
scaleUpThreshold: 0.68  # target gpu util before scaling up
maxNodeProvisioningTime: 240  # seconds
bufferPool: 0.30  # keep 30% spare capacity for bursts
nodeProvisioningConcurrency: 2
```
Use conservative scaleUpThreshold to avoid overshoot.

samir: also add a cooldown on scale-down to avoid flapping when batch jobs finish: set coolDownSeconds: 600. we had oscillations at 120s earlier.

liz: can we enable prefix/KV caching for common prefixes during soak to reduce token cost and smooth latency? yes — enable for the test model: model/redwood-2b-v1.

cheng: test traffic generator command (run from perfbox):
```
perfgen --model redwood-2b-v1 --qps 75 --concurrency 8 --duration 21600 --batch_strategy adaptive
```
Phase1 target: qps tuned to hit 70% GPU util. validate with prom query `avg_over_time(gpu_util[5m])`.

infra-bot: [alert-config] created temporary alerts for soak:
- gpu_utilization_warning: avg_over_time(gpu_util[5m]) > 0.75
- gpu_utilization_critical: avg_over_time(gpu_util[1m]) > 0.90
- node_restarts_critical: increase in kube_node_info restarts > 3 within 10m
- controlplane_conn_errors: kube_apiserver_request_total{code!~"2.."} increase > 5x baseline

aj: small debug note: if control-plane errors spike during cross-AZ, we should toggle cluster-proxy fallback to local-region-only for a few minutes (handy knob). details in runbook.

samir: during yesterday's smoke logs looked like this (excerpt):
```
I0318 14:12:02.123 kubelet: Evicting pods due to pressure: memory available 120Mi < threshold
E0318 14:12:05.412 node-controller: failed to update node status: Post "https://apiserver...": dial tcp: i/o timeout
W0318 14:12:06.009 cloud-provider: route update failed: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection closed
```
I think ephemeral NAT gateway limits + burst egress to control plane was a contributor.

liz: action item: @aj can you add a temporary NAT scaling rule and raise egress concurrency limit for the soak window? @samir please monitor route table churn.

aj: will do. I'll patch NAT scaling and set egressConcurrency=250 for the soak.

cheng: cost note — running a 10-hr combined soak with H100 spot bursts estimated ~ $4.8k for eu-west3. if we keep H100 spot as burst only we should be in ~$3.2k range. eyeballing total commit vs experience: worth it.

kari: handoff checklist once soak passes:
- confirm 6h single-AZ metrics stable (gpu_util p50/p95 within target)
- validate rollout policy: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% on region
- update autoscaler defaults for region with tuned params and cooldowns
- open PR for capacity request (increase GPU quota to 64)
- schedule post-soak retrospective (owners: cheng/samir/aj)

samir: I'll run the monitoring dashboard and capture traces. ping me if alerts fire.

liz: i'll run the eval harness for quality regressions during soak windows. quick check: enable structured logs for inference to tie latency to prompt families.

cheng: cool. I'll start phase1 at 1912347400 (in ~11m). tagging this thread for the weekend run. :rocket:

infra-bot: note: autoscaler config patch created at 1912346890 by aj (PR #4582).

aj: patch applied. NAT scaling + egressConcurrency updated. starting perfgen soon.

samir: monitoring alert template for control-plane flap created. thresholds will mute non-actionable flaps for the first 5m to avoid noise.

liz: thumbs up. I'll be watching quality signals.

cheng: thanks all — will post results and a short retrospective in this thread after the soak.
